description: Welcome home to 10831 Odell Ave — a sun-drenched 1948 Mid-Century charmer tucked into the Sunland foothills and priced to be the most affordable detached home story you'll tell this year. Inside, original wood-beamed ceilings, hardwood-style flooring, and oversized windows pour natural light across an open living and dining flow. French doors swing open to a private outdoor patio — quintessential California indoor-outdoor living for morning coffee, weekend BBQs, or stargazing under the San Gabriels. Two true bedrooms, a clean full bath, and a converted 1-car garage that works beautifully as a third bedroom, home office, creative studio, or future ADU. Step outside and you're minutes from Angeles National Forest trails, Oro Vista Park, Tujunga Ponds Wildlife Sanctuary, and the cafés, taquerias, and antique shops of Foothill Blvd. Quick I-210 access puts Burbank studios, Glendale, Pasadena, and Downtown LA (˜ 20 mi) within easy commute. Zoned for Apperson Street Elementary, Mount Gleason Middle, and Verdugo Hills High. A rare under-$600K entry point into one of LA's most up-and-coming foothill neighborhoods — perfect for first-time buyers, creative professionals working from home, or investors eyeing long-term value and ADU upside. Don't miss this one.
